channel.title: Private Credit Wire

item.title: Meridian Credit Partners provides $450m unitranche facility to Vantage Logistics
item.description: Meridian Credit Partners has provided a $450 million senior secured unitranche facility to Vantage Logistics to back the operator's Sun Belt expansion.

item.title: Harbourline Capital closes Senior Lending Fund II at $1.75bn hard cap
item.description: Harbourline Capital has held the final close of Harbourline Senior Lending Fund II at its $1.75 billion hard cap.
